Marker keys were observed admitted by the decoder; generated-output corruption was not established. The no-marker validation now covers keys as well as values.

The broader probing turn ended with a provider safeguard. The worker supplied its existing report and reran only the already established target-boundary correctness checks. Starter sequencing and additional host-admission probes were not executed.
